title: DOW-UAP-D27, Mission Report, United Arab Emirates, October 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified U.S. Military Mission Report (MISREP) detailing an ISR mission in the Gulf of Oman, including a specific UAP observation report.

incidents.summary: A glowing hot spherical object with a vertical cylindrical pole attached to the bottom was observed moving at 140 knots over the water.
incidents.quote: GLOWING HOT SPHERICAL UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT WITH A VERTICAL UNWAVERING CYLINDRICAL POLE/BAR ATTACHED ON THE BOTTOM
